component.name: Maintainer
component.summary: Monitor, maintain, diagnose, and understand your Linux system

description.p: Maintainer is a modern, lightweight native desktop application for monitoring, maintaining, diagnosing, and understanding Ubuntu-based Linux computers.
It provides one calm place to:

ul.li: Understand CPU, memory, storage, temperature, network, and process activity
Inspect available system, Flatpak, and firmware updates where supported
Diagnose failed services and recurring journal events
Inspect SMART storage health where supported
Generate a useful, privacy-conscious local system report

description.p: Maintainer does not promise fake optimization, automatic duplicate deletion, cloud monitoring, or arbitrary system tweaking. The GUI always runs unprivileged. No permanent daemon. No telemetry.
